description: Read-only: returns questions and estimates; it creates nothing and moves no funds. Call this first when the user wants to launch a token. Pass anything they have already decided. Returns the questions to ask them (shaped for AskUserQuestion), estimated costs for each first-buy choice, and the field limits. Ask the questions and confirm the summary with the user before calling launch_token.

description.description: Short description shown on pump.fun. 500 characters max.

idea.description: What the user wants the token to be about, in their words.

imageSvg.description: A logo you drew as an SVG document, if you've made one.

imageUrl.description: https link to the token image, if the user gave one.

initialBuySol.description: First buy in SOL as a decimal string, e.g. "0.1", if decided. 0 to 5.

name.description: Token name, as the user chose it. 32 characters max.

site.description: false if the user doesn't want a free token site.

siteAccent.description: Token site accent color, #RRGGBB, bright enough for dark text.

siteName.description: A site address the user asked for, e.g. rocket-coin. start_launch says if it's free.

story.description: Text for the token site: a few plain paragraphs, 2,000 characters max.

symbol.description: Ticker, e.g. RKT. 10 characters max, usually 3–6 capital letters.

website.description: The token's own website, https. Leave it out to use the free token site.

name: start_launch
title: Start a token launch
